name: Konstantin Chernenko
role: Leader of the Soviet Union from 1984 to 1985
contribution: A Soviet politician who served as the de jure leader of the Soviet Union from February 1984 until his death in March 1985.

checks.lead: Konstantin Ustinovich Chernenko (24 September [O.S. 11 September] 1911 – 10 March 1985) was a Soviet politician who served as the de jure leader of the Soviet Union from February 1984 until his death in March 1985.
